messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Dump data from R
parts:
How does one dump data stored in R into a text file formatted as an Rdump
(that can then be read into CmdStan)?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Dump data from R
parts:
stan_rdump()

If the data is in a list, say x, then:
stan_rdump(ls(x), "x.data.R", envir=list2env(x))

> On Mar 5, 2015, at 5:56 AM, Daniel Lee <bea...@alum.mit.edu> wrote:
>
> stan_rdump()
>
> If the data is in a list, say x, then:
> stan_rdump(ls(x), "x.data.R", envir=list2env(x))

Neat! I didn't know about ls() and hadn't realized you
could pass an environment to stan_rdump() --- that's great
because you can get away from using globals everywhere.

Before, I had always just defined a and b in the global namespace and use

stan_rdump(c("a","b"), "x.data.R");

- Bob
